name: SuQing's Freshness Lunchbox
description: Moves the regular bottom attachment upward toward the Legendary Backpack base. Fixes B42.21 vehicle Set iteration, attached model registration and long item tooltips. 0.1.0-rc.8 single-player backpack-bottom attachment candidate. Uses existing normal, large or ALICE bedroll/tent slots, shared with their original items; adds no slots or mandatory backpack dependency. A dedicated attached model reuses the current mesh and texture. Attached boxes retain container access, food storage and freshness restoration. Ordinary Container Upgrades 1.0.3 requires detaching and emptying before upgrades/restoration. Retains either-hand carrying, food restrictions, starting capacity 4/weight 1/reduction 50%, sandbox settings, upgrade records and the rc.5 ground outline. Item IDs and foods stay intact. Offline candidate only; positioning, animations, Viewpoint and save/reload require user acceptance.
